title: September Updates: New Personalization Features in Customily (2026)
summary: September 2026 updates are live! Discover Image Reference for Image Effects, Copy & Paste Color Options, and Customily’s new Color Picker.
body_markdown:
September was all about giving you more control over your designs while making everyday workflows faster. We introduced **Image Reference for Image Effects** , giving AI image transformations more visual context to work with, along with **Copy & Paste Color Options Between Elements** to speed up design setup. We also launched the **new Color Picker** , making it easier to choose and manage colors while creating personalized products.


Let’s dive into what’s new! 🚀


## Design Element: Text Along Path 🆕


Create eye-catching text designs with our new Text Along Path element! ✨


Add text that follows a curve or custom shape, giving you more flexibility to create unique and creative designs.


**👉🏻**[Learn how to set it up here!](https://customily.userjot.com/updates/p/text-along-path) ‍


## A Better Way to Use Image Masks 🎭


We’ve made a few improvements to Masks for Image Placeholders to make them easier and faster to use.


You can now:


- See the applied mask clearly
- Choose from pre-made shapes
- Reuse your own shapes


👉🏻[Check out what's new here!](https://customily.userjot.com/updates/p/image-upload-masks) ‍


## Image Reference for Image Effects 🪄


You can now add reference images to your Image Effects, alongside your written prompt, when generating images inside Image Placeholders.


Instead of describing every detail in your prompt, simply provide an image to show the AI the style, look, composition, or visual direction you have in mind.


👉🏻[Learn more about it here!](https://customily.userjot.com/updates/p/image-reference-for-image-effects)


## Section & Swatch Styles on Product-Level Settings 🚀


You can now customize Section Styles and Swatch Styles directly at the product level.


**What’s new:**


- **Section Styles:** Apply specific section styles to individual products, such as navigation buttons, accordions, and colors.
- **Swatch & Text Swatch Styles:** Apply your chosen swatch styles, including text swatches, to individual products.


👉🏻[Check out what's new here!](https://customily.userjot.com/updates/p/section-swatch-styles-on-product-level-settings)


## Copy & Paste Color Options Between Elements 🎨


Updating colors across multiple elements just got a lot easier. With Copy & Paste Color Options, you can now copy color settings from one element and paste them onto another, just like you already can with Dimensions & Positions.


This makes it easier to keep your designs consistent without having to manually set the same colors over and over again.


👉🏻[Check out what's new here!](https://customily.userjot.com/updates/p/copy-paste-color-options-between-elements)


## Introducing the New Color Picker 🎨


We've launched a new color picker experience, bringing the classic color selection interface to both desktop and mobile!


**What's new?** The new Popover Picker provides a consistent color selection experience across devices, making it easier for customers to choose the exact colors they want when personalizing products.


👉🏻[Learn more about it here!](https://customily.userjot.com/updates/p/new-color-picker) ‍

**Happy customizing! ⭐** ‍
